$comment: ufw (unfoldingWord) -> KJV-English verse map for Door43 resources declaring versification: ufw.
Rule format as versification-mt-to-kjv.json: {b,c,from,to,dc,off}; `off` is added to the verse number, `dc` is the destination chapter.
`merges` mirror VARIANT_VERSE_MAP in sword2bible.cpp: the source verse is folded into a KJV host verse (prefix=true puts it before the host's own text).
Evidence (samples 2026-11-10): ufw OT is English-shaped (Joel 3 chapters 20/32/21, Obadiah 21); the NT follows the critical text, so 3JN has 15 verses and Rev 12 has 18.
Anything outside the rules that is not a KJV address raises UnmappedVerse. TODO: derive_versification script (subtask D3) not written; rules here are the pragmatic section 5.1 set.

merges.note: critical-text 3 John 15 = second half of KJV 3 John 14
